rooms.name: Millford Square
rooms.description: You stand in the middle of a broad cobbled square, worn smooth by generations of boots. A moss-ringed stone well sits at its heart. Timber-framed houses lean in on every side, and the road north leads back out through the village gate.

details.well: The old stone well is ringed with moss. Cool air rises from its depths, and far below you can hear the faint drip of water.
details.houses: Crooked timber-framed houses, their shutters half closed. Smoke curls from most of the chimneys.
